query: How will Monte Carlo stress-tests be parameterized (distributions, correlations, scenario sets for tariffs/FX/demand shocks) and what go/no-go probability thresholds will we set?

response.query: How will Monte Carlo stress-tests be parameterized (distributions, correlations, scenario sets for tariffs/FX/demand shocks) and what go/no-go probability thresholds will we set?
response.answer: Monte Carlo stress-tests will use normal distributions for tariffs, FX, and demand shocks, with correlations set based on historical data. Go/no-go thresholds will be set at 95% confidence levels.
